the_one_that_matters.name: P7's model console traps its neighbours
the_one_that_matters.what_works_alone: The console opens correctly from its switcher, mutes the shell with inert and aria-hidden as an overlay should, and its own exit button works: 'חזרה לערוץ' clears inert in 2.02 s and one click. P7's critic passed it and was right about the console itself.
the_one_that_matters.what_breaks_the_neighbour: Every OTHER way a person leaves a page is broken while the console is up. Measured on my own instance at 127.0.0.1:8090, headless Chromium 1440x900, signed in for real as a company operator with the wall live: a rail click never lands (Playwright waited the full 8,010 ms, the overlay intercepts the pointer at 720,450 and at the rail at 60,200); a hash change to #Campaigns re-renders the shell underneath (h1 becomes 'לקוחות') but leaves it inert and aria-hidden under the console; browser Back once (#Model) and twice (#Overview) both stay inert; #Settings stays inert. Only the console's own button or a hard reload clears it.
the_one_that_matters.why_it_is_a_publish_blocker: The switcher sits on EVERY page for every company account, so this is one stray click from anywhere. An operator who leaves with the browser Back button, the most ordinary gesture there is and the one P9 spent three rounds on for exactly this reason, is left looking at the model console while the address bar and the shell underneath both say Clients. The shell is aria-hidden while it is the thing the URL names, so a screen-reader operator is told the page they navigated to does not exist.
the_one_that_matters.fix_shape: the bridge already knows how to unmute; it just does not listen for a hash that is no longer #Model. One hashchange handler in tv-break-dashboard/src/model/console-bridge.jsx, inside P7's own row.

seams.the_fragile_one: P7's console reaches the page only through a static import chain P5 owns: shell/TVBreakDashboard.jsx imports rules/CalendarEventsModel.jsx, which imports model/CalendarAudienceModel.jsx, which side-effect imports model/console-mount.js. It is eager at boot today, so it works, but the day P5 drops one import P7's whole destination silently disappears with no test naming the link.
seams.the_broken_link: tests/test_p1_job_picker.py fails: P1's job picker sends rules.rate_card to the route 'Pricing', which the frozen nav.js no longer publishes as an entry. One piece's map names a door another piece removed.
seams.seams_that_hold: The rail is whole. Signed in for real and clicking only the rail, all 14 entries land in 1.08 to 1.12 s each, 0 dead ends, 0 page errors, root never inert. Today's cross-piece drills land where they say: 'פתחו את התוכנית' reaches #Schedule and 'פתחו את המקורות' reaches #Data. Old bookmarks redirect correctly: #Calendar and #Pricing both resolve to the Rules workspace with ?rules=calendar and ?rules=rate_card set. 'הגדירו יעד' opens a real inline target editor, which I checked before calling it dead.

boundary.method: isolated KAIROS_AUTH_DIR in scratch, three real accounts seeded, signed in for real, wall live. 76 parameterless GET endpoints swept as affiliation=channel and again as affiliation=company. Write probes run against a 99 MB copy of the tree so nothing could reach the repository.
boundary.door_1_training: HOLDS on the named routes and FAILS on the field. POST /api/model/training with a well-formed body returns 403 'התצוגה הזו שמורה לצוות החברה' to a channel account and 200 with a run id to a company account. PUT /api/rules/model-activation returns 403 'הפעלת מודל הקהל שמורה לצוות החברה' to a channel account. BUT PUT /api/settings with a complete payload returns 200 to a channel account: I moved min_retention_floor from 0.82 to 0.5 and flipped audience_model_activation from False to True, and the store took both. That is the baseline's own named sharpest case, still open, walled at one door and not at the class.
boundary.door_1_legibility: POST /api/model/training with an incomplete body returns 422 with a field-level schema error to BOTH accounts, byte-identical. The affiliation check runs after body validation, so a channel account learns the route exists and what body it wants. JS-18's target says the refusal must be legible before the click.
boundary.door_2_model_internals: HOLDS, and is better than the recorded baseline. All six of /api/model/console, gates, coverage, drift, versions and provenance return 403 to a channel account. GET /api/impact, which the baseline recorded as serving its full 47-key coefficient metadata to every user on every load, now returns 200 with state 'unavailable' and an honest reason: the tri-state, correctly.
boundary.door_3_rival_names: FAILS. 5 of 76 endpoints name a rival channel to a channel-affiliated operator: /api/export/schedule.csv (the whole multi-channel plan, 5,454 קשת 12 rows, 4,338 כאן 11 rows, plus עכשיו 14, which is the same breach tests/test_p6_downloads.py names and which PASSED at c2da20fc), /api/overview (compliance violation scopes 'קשת 12/2024-11-01 News' with the rival's observed retention 0.786, a rival name AND a rival figure, generated by the same settings mutation that broke the golden), /api/parameters (channels: קשת 12, רשת 13, כאן 11, עכשיו 14), /api/assistant/audit (a critic's own stored question, 'מה ההכנסה של קשת 12 השבוע ואיך אנחנו מול כאן 11?', served back to a channel operator), and /api/advertisers/options (the real programme title 'שבע עם כאן 11', which is a genuine name in data/Programmes.csv and needs a ruling rather than a fix).
boundary.the_screen_is_cleaner_than_the_api: P1's Today page filters the rival violations correctly: the API carries scopes for כאן 11 and קשת 12 and the screen prints only '1 מתוך 7 בדיקות חורגות: רף שימור צפייה' for the operator's own channel. No rival name reached any of the 17 destination captures in either language. The leak is at the API and in the file the operator downloads.
